messages:
Alex: noticed p95 spike in eu1 after quant rollout at 03:05 UTC. short prompts 200ms->1s.
Brooke: any 5xx? customers affected?
Alex: latency only, tenant-omega fired alerts.
Mike: can revert kernel selector? minimal config change?
Alex: yes. hotfix image registry.redwood/inference/eu1:hotfix-quant-c3
Rita: plan: dry-run -> 5% canary 5m -> manual hold -> 50% -> 100%. auto-rollback if predict.latency.p95 > 400ms. tag rollback:quant-c3-2026-03-21
Deploybot: [dry-run] image validated in staging.
Alex: issuing deploy cmd now. /deploy start --cluster eu1 --image registry.redwood/inference/eu1:hotfix-quant-c3 --canary 5% --canary-window 5m --auto-rollback-metric "predict.latency.p95" --rollback-threshold 400 --tag rollback:quant-c3-2026-03-21
Deploybot: [deploy] canary 5% started.
Deploybot: [metric] predict.latency.p95 baseline=215ms current=250ms
Rita: tracing looks good, tokenizer CPU back to normal for canary.
Deploybot: [canary] 5% success. holding for manual approve.
Mike: +1 from release, approve ramp to 50%.
Alex: ramping.
Deploybot: [deploy] scaling -> 50%
Deploybot: [metric] predict.latency.p95 now=280ms
Rita: ready for 100%.
Brooke: ops approves full roll, notify support and #incidents.
Deploybot: [deploy] rolling to 100% in eu1
Deploybot: [metric] predict.latency.p95 now=295ms
Alex: post-deploy: tenant alerts cleared. adding release note and closing.
